title: MoBiQuant: Mixture-of-Bits Quantization for Token-Adaptive Any-Precision LLM
abstract: arXiv:2602.20191v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dynamic runtime latency and memory constraints necessitate flexible large language model (LLM) deployment, where an LLM can be inferred with various quantization precisions based on available computational resources. Recent work on such any-precision quantization either relies on hardware-inefficient vector quantization or induces additional scaling factors when switching between bit-widths. Meanwhile, existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods calibrated for a fixed low precision show poor generalizability under runtime precision change. In this work, we attribute the source of poor generalization across bit-widths to a precision-dependent outlier migration phenomenon where the distribution of PTQ-sensitive tokens changes across precisions. translated_title: MoBiQuant：面向Token自适应任意精度大语言模型的比特混合量化
translated_abstract: 动态的运行时延迟和内存约束要求大语言模型（LLM）能够灵活部署，即LLM可以根据可用的计算资源以不同的量化精度进行推理。近期关于此类任意精度量化的工作要么依赖于硬件效率低下的向量量化，要么在位宽切换时引入额外的缩放因子。同时，现有的针对固定低精度校准的训练后量化（PTQ）方法在运行时精度变化的情况下泛化能力较差。在本工作中，我们将这种跨位宽泛化能力差的根源归因于一种精度相关的离群值迁移现象，即对PTQ敏感的token的分布在不同精度下会发生变化。受此观察启发，我们提出了MoBiQuant，一种新颖的任意精度比特混合量化框架，能够基于token（自适应地）调整权重精度，实现灵活的LLM推理。
tldr: 提出MoBiQuant框架，通过发现“精度相关的离群值迁移”现象并采用比特混合量化机制，实现可根据token和运行时资源自适应切换位宽的任意精度LLM高效推理。
en_tdlr: MoBiQuant introduces an any-precision Mixture-of-Bits quantization framework that enables token-adaptive, flexible LLM inference across bit-widths by addressing the precision-dependent outlier migration phenomenon in post-training quantization.
